user.title: Configure active-fire data sources
user.description: TerraLyra automatically assigns every relevant source to each monitored location. LSA SAF requires a free account, while NOAA GOES needs no account.

monitoring_center.title: Choose the active-fire monitoring center
monitoring_center.description: Use Home for normal operation, or enter another location to test or monitor a separate area. This center affects active-fire providers, distances, alerts, NASA FIRMS and fire markers. FRMv3 fire risk and land-surface temperature remain tied to Home.

data_description.use_custom_monitoring_center: Leave off to use Home Assistant's Home location.
data_description.monitoring_center_name: A short recognizable name, such as New York or Holiday home.

sources.title: Connect optional active-fire sources
sources.description: TerraLyra automatically assigns every relevant source to each monitored location. NOAA GOES needs no credentials. Add LSA SAF credentials and/or a NASA FIRMS MAP_KEY to extend coverage; leave fields blank to skip that source.

lsa_saf.title: Connect to LSA SAF Data Service
lsa_saf.description: Enter the credentials from your free LSA SAF Data Service account. The integration provides MTG Active Fire Detection and the FRMv3 fire-risk forecast.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthentication required
reauth_confirm.description: The LSA SAF Data Service rejected the saved credentials. Enter the username and current password for the same account.

data_description.username: Username of the originally configured LSA SAF account
data_description.password: Current LSA SAF Data Service password

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the LSA SAF Data Service
error.goes_not_available: The selected monitoring center is outside the safe NOAA GOES coverage area
error.invalid_monitoring_center: Enter a valid monitoring-center name and coordinates
error.invalid_firms_key: The NASA FIRMS MAP_KEY was rejected
error.lsa_credentials_incomplete: Enter both the LSA SAF username and password, or leave both blank
error.no_source_available: No automatic source covers this location. Add LSA SAF credentials or a NASA FIRMS MAP_KEY

abort.already_configured: This LSA SAF account is already configured
abort.wrong_account: The new credentials belong to a different LSA SAF account

data.use_custom_monitoring_center: Use a custom active-fire monitoring center
data.resolve_place_names: Show nearby place names on the map

data_description.radius_km: Only detections within this distance of the active-fire monitoring center are considered.
data_description.manage_monitored_locations: Select this and save to add, edit, enable, disable or delete monitored locations.
data_description.use_custom_monitoring_center: Off uses Home Assistant's Home location. On uses the separate name and coordinates below for active-fire data, distances, alerts and NASA FIRMS. Fire risk and land-surface temperature remain tied to Home.
data_description.monitoring_center_name: A short name shown in provider details and fire notifications. Used only when the custom center is enabled.
data_description.monitoring_latitude: Decimal degrees from -90 to 90. Used only when the custom center is enabled.
data_description.monitoring_longitude: Decimal degrees from -180 to 180. Used only when the custom center is enabled.
data_description.fire_risk_radius_km: Area shown on the FRMv3 map and checked for the highest regional fire risk. This does not change active-fire alerts.
data_description.min_confidence: 0 includes all detections; 1 is the strictest possible filter.
data_description.min_frp_mw: Ignore detections weaker than this FRP in MW.
data_description.scan_interval_minutes: How often Home Assistant checks the automatically assigned active-fire sources for newer products.
data_description.dedup_radius_km: A detection near a recently seen fire is treated as the same fire and will not generate another new-fire event.
data_description.dedup_hours: How long a recently seen fire suppresses repeat new-fire events in the same area.
data_description.fire_history_hours: How long inactive fire markers remain visible on the map. This does not extend repeat-alert suppression.
data_description.resolve_place_names: Find the nearest settlement locally using the bundled GeoNames cities500 database. No coordinates are sent to an external service.
data_description.enable_land_surface_temperature: Optional and off by default. When enabled, Home Assistant sends the Home latitude and longitude about every 15 minutes to the official LSA SAF WMS service at adaguc.lsasvcs.ipma.pt to retrieve the latest satellite-observed land-surface temperature.
data_description.enable_firms: When enabled, NASA FIRMS NOAA-20/21 VIIRS and Terra/Aqua MODIS observations are assigned as equal satellite evidence to every monitored location. Home Assistant sends a small bounding box around each enabled location to the official FIRMS API. A free personal MAP_KEY is required.
data_description.firms_map_key: Stored as a secret in the Home Assistant config entry and redacted from diagnostics. Leave blank to keep an already saved key.

error.firms_key_required: Enter a NASA FIRMS MAP_KEY before enabling corroboration
error.invalid_firms_key: The NASA FIRMS MAP_KEY was rejected
error.firms_cannot_connect: Could not validate the NASA FIRMS MAP_KEY
error.invalid_monitoring_center: Enter a valid monitoring-center name and coordinates
error.invalid_monitored_location: Enter a valid name, coordinates and radius
error.one_location_required: At least one monitored location must remain enabled
error.too_many_locations: A maximum of 10 monitored locations is supported

provider_authentication.title: Active-fire source authentication failed
provider_authentication.description: TerraLyra cannot authenticate with a configured active-fire source. Open the integration settings, verify the credentials, and reload the integration.

provider_outage.title: Active-fire sources are repeatedly unavailable
provider_outage.description: All assigned active-fire sources failed {failures} consecutive updates. Check the source services and this Home Assistant instance's internet access, then reload the integration. Other TerraLyra products may continue to update.

upstream_provider_issue.title: {service} needs attention
upstream_provider_issue.description: {service} reported {failure} for {failures} consecutive updates. TerraLyra is retrying it with a bounded delay while other healthy sources continue. Check the service credentials and availability if this persists.

upstream_goes_issue.title: NOAA GOES data needs attention
upstream_goes_issue.description: {service} reported {failure} for {failures} consecutive updates. NOAA GOES requires no credentials. TerraLyra is retrying automatically with a bounded delay while other healthy sources continue; check NOAA service availability if this persists.

fire_risk_outage.title: Fire-risk forecast service is repeatedly unavailable
fire_risk_outage.description: The FRMv3 forecast service failed {failures} consecutive refreshes (last reason: {reason}). TerraLyra is retrying automatically with a bounded delay; active-fire monitoring and other healthy products continue normally. This notice clears after recovery.

provider_coverage.title: No configured active-fire source covers some monitored locations
provider_coverage.description: TerraLyra cannot currently assign a usable source to: {locations}. Add the required LSA SAF credentials or NASA FIRMS MAP_KEY, or change the monitored locations. Other covered locations continue updating.

supplemental_fire_count.name: Active-fire clusters observed by NASA FIRMS

fire_risk_area_maximum.name: Highest fire risk in monitoring area

recent_detections.name: Fire detections in the last hour

fire_activity_frp_change.name: Fire activity FRP change over one hour

new_incidents_24h.name: New fire incidents in the last 24 hours
